newsitem.title: EGYPT: Suspected militants kill policeman in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Suspected militants kill policeman in Egypt.

text.p: Suspected Moslem militants killed one Egyptian policeman and wounded five others when they opened fire on a police convoy on Monday, security sources said.
"The armed men fled away after they opened fire at the last vehicle of a column of police vehicles," one source said.
Policeman Nageh Obeid Hanna was killed near the city of Minya, some 240 km (150 miles) from Cairo.

The sources said the men are suspected to be members of the Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group), the largest militant group fighting the Egyptian government in its bid to establish a purist Islamic state.
More than 1,000 people have been killed and hundreds more wounded since the Gama'a launched an armed campaign in 1992.
